Before Anything Is Ordered

  • Concepts only. Nothing has been ordered or priced.
  • Brand line on every piece. Each item carries LE SCAPE or Luxury Turf + Landscaping in small plain lettering, on a sleeve, hem, back strap or base.
  • Mockups are illustrative. Sayings are set in The Seasons and Garet. Final print files and garment colors are confirmed before ordering.
  • Your part: mark which sayings feel like you, which to cut, and anything you would add.
